title: Junction: a VS Code sidebar that runs your local coding agent inside the editor
description:
Running a local coding agent from a separate terminal means constant context-switching and copy-pasting between two windows. Junction pulls it inside VS Code. A chat sidebar for local AI coding agents that lives right next to your code. Point it at files, watch changes land in your project, never leave the editor. The whole agent loop in one window, where you actually work. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/Plaer1/junction
